seo.title: Visit us in Montevideo: service times and directions
seo.description: Plan your first visit to El Ancla Baptist Church: Sunday service times, how to get here, what to expect and answers to the most common questions.

hero.title: Plan your visit.
hero.body: What you need to know before coming: when we start, where we are and what you will find. You don't need to sign up or let us know.

where.title: Av. Luis A. de Herrera, at Juan Arrieta.
where.body: Open the route in Google Maps from wherever you are.
where.mapLabel: Map of the area around the church

expect.title: A simple service centered on the Bible.

items.title: We sing
items.text: We praise God together with songs everyone can follow.

items.title: We pray
items.text: We give thanks and pray for the church and for those in need.

items.title: We open the Bible
items.text: A message that explains a passage of Scripture and applies it to daily life.

items.title: We talk
items.text: Afterwards you are welcome to stay and say hello. No one will rush you.

items.a: Sundays at 11:15 AM. At 10:00 AM there is Bible school for adults and children.
At Av. Luis A. de Herrera 3101, at the corner of Juan Arrieta, Montevideo.
It ends around 1:00 PM. You are welcome to stay and chat afterwards.

items.q: Do I need to be a member or tell you I'm coming?
items.a: No. Anyone can come, with no sign-up and no commitment.

items.q: What does El Ancla Baptist Church believe?
items.a: We are a Baptist church centered on the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our doctrine is explained in the statement of faith.

items.q: Can I watch the service without coming?
items.a: Yes. We stream live on YouTube and sermons stay available in the sermons section.

items.q: How can I contact the church?
items.a: Write to contacto@elancla.uy or find us on YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.
